what_is_preserved: complaints, judgments, case rounds, named legal roles
systematic_omissions: informal deliberation, membership change, actions that never enter court
visibility_effect: Creates exact dates and durable named roles; can make lawyers/plaintiff groups look structurally central.
analytic_use: Compare ENTRY/RECORD/RELIEF and keep case roles separate from alliances.
forbidden_inference: Court visibility is not movement influence or project change.

what_is_preserved: direct requests, signature validation, ordinances, vote results, executive decisions
systematic_omissions: campaign discussions, internal coalition dynamics, post-vote informal effects
visibility_effect: Preserves institutional gates and makes blocked/reinterpreted participation visible.
analytic_use: Model the full gate chain rather than a single referendum event.
forbidden_inference: A vote record is not a binding veto or a complete measure of public opinion effects.

systematic_omissions: unsubmitted local knowledge, rejected framing, internal drafting
visibility_effect: Favors organizations able to write, host and preserve formal scientific/legal documents.
analytic_use: Study procedural translation and source-host dependence.
forbidden_inference: Formal submission is not acceptance or project suspension.

what_is_preserved: legal identity, certification and some annual-report obligations
systematic_omissions: informal groups, unions, case committees, U.S. entities and organizations outside NPO status
visibility_effect: The December 1998 NPO-law implementation added a standardized certification/disclosure channel for one legal form; later internet publication expanded unevenly.
analytic_use: Use as one document-regime anchor and compare matched legal forms rather than imposing a single visibility breakpoint.
forbidden_inference: Certified-NPO growth is not growth/professionalization of base-accountability organizations or a universal web-visibility shift.

what_is_preserved: board minutes, case files, annual reports, policy proposals and staff roles
systematic_omissions: restricted personal case files and institutions whose records were never deposited
visibility_effect: Makes one care institution unusually traceable across governance, practice and rights translation.
analytic_use: Use as a deep historical case with explicit archive-selection boundaries.
forbidden_inference: One preserved collection is not the complete service ecology.

what_is_preserved: selected donations, aggregate giving, visits and relationship narratives
systematic_omissions: failed activities, recipient dissent, non-public transfers and ordinary routine
visibility_effect: Systematically selects positive relationship-building episodes and may compress genealogy.
analytic_use: Use for LEG0/LEG1 and as a lead for recipient-side checking.
forbidden_inference: Public-affairs visibility is not independent evidence of legitimacy or social effect.

what_is_preserved: organization totals, officers, named large recipients and some purposes
systematic_omissions: Schedule B donor names, small/unitemized endpoints and local allocation below national organizations
visibility_effect: Creates a modern resource/person record that is much denser than the historical web record.
analytic_use: Use in W2-A as a dated money/person ledger; never merge unlike tax periods.
forbidden_inference: A filing amount does not disclose donor identity, political intent or recipient response.

what_is_preserved: formation claims, public milestones, named events and retrospective identity
systematic_omissions: failed organizations, internal disputes, unpublicized continuity and precise legal transitions
visibility_effect: Current survivors narrate their own past and can crowd out short-lived carriers.
analytic_use: Cross-check against official records, archives and contemporaneous materials.
forbidden_inference: Surviving website visibility is not historical centrality or uninterrupted continuity.

what_is_preserved: temporary committees, flyers, opinion ads, meeting carriers and local wording
systematic_omissions: Mostly absent from open web; often available only in libraries or personal archives
visibility_effect: Its absence creates the sharpest Sakishima and event-carrier gaps.
analytic_use: Dispatch exact local retrieval tasks tied to named claims.
forbidden_inference: Online absence is not organizational absence or inactivity.
